answer_2.quote: We use the bias score (B) to assess the generation bias of diffusion models and the quality score (Q) to evaluate the visual quality of generated images... Specifically, we compute Q using the CLIP score between the generated images and the corresponding prompt... The bias score B quantifies the absolute difference between the actual and target proportions...
